import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
print('full-row dups:', df.duplicated().sum())
print('feature-dup groups with conflicting outcome:', (df.groupby(list(df.columns[:-1])).outcome.nunique()>1).sum())
d=df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

tr.to_csv('train.csv',index=False); te.to_csv('test.csv',index=False)
print(len(d),len(tr),len(te), tr.outcome.mean().round(3), te.outcome.mean().round(3))
